label: SCG I.22 dependently joined quiddity is not the per se necessary bearer's quiddity
paraphrase: At a selected world, for every bearer x and every s: if x's represented esse e is per se necessary in the dependence sense (PER_SE_NECESSARY_2), x is ontically identified with e, e is joined to x's proposed quiddity q, and that joining depends on some s other than e, then q is not x's genuine quiddity. Conditional on the first n.4 case (intelligible apart makes q accidental; accident is not quiddity of an esse-identified bearer), the second n.4 case and n.2's per se clause. It does not assert q = e, does not deny x's actual q.3 essence, and does not cover a joining with no source or with e itself as its only source.
